assertions.why: the skill file itself must exist for forge-research-evidence to be usable at all
every description stays <=200 chars (skill-load budget); W2-WIRE keeps this one near 90 for the listing
the discipline is built on the citation ledger; a removed tool must turn this eval red
every logged claim carries the date the source said it
the coverage gate must run before a research result is reported

assertions.needle: Reopen the original, never cite a summary
assertions.why: a summary is a pointer to a source, not the source

assertions.needle: looks for the strongest source that says otherwise
assertions.why: the counter-review pass must look for disconfirming sources, not re-read the same ones
the named anti-pattern is part of the discipline

assertions.needle: | Compose | two or more existing tools cover it together
assertions.why: the Adopt/Extend/Compose/Build matrix with its evidence column must stay in the skill
an outside-capability search must lead to forge-scout's preflight table and the adopt-step security audit
the citations doctor check that turns red when the matcher breaks must exist
